cases.title: Login and portrait workspace
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1; local QA service on port 3173
steps: Configure the loopback service and sign in to the isolated QA account; verify three document kinds and the 3 GB indicator.

cases.title: Word portrait and landscape keyboard layout
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1; local QA service on port 3173
steps: Enter Tablet QA. Show the software keyboard and rotate to landscape; caret, document and toolbar remain visible. Server readback confirms exact text.

cases.title: Landscape spreadsheet formula and save
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1; local QA service on port 3173
steps: Enter =120+80 through the formula bar, observe A1=200 and save. Server readback preserves the formula. Software keyboard geometry for sheets was not tested.

cases.title: Landscape slide editing and presentation exit
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1; local QA service on port 3173
steps: Replace the title with iPad QA, save, start presentation and close using the visible close control. Server readback confirms the title.

cases.title: Word Chinese Pinyin candidate composition and persistence
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1; local QA service on port 3173
steps: Open the existing Word fixture, add a paragraph, switch the native software keyboard from Roman keys to Pinyin, tap n/i and choose the Chinese candidate, then h/a/o and choose its candidate; add Chinese punctuation and save.
Read back the exact two paragraphs through the local API; terminate/relaunch the app and reopen the document.

results.notes: Configure the loopback service and sign in to the isolated QA account; verify three document kinds and the 3 GB indicator.
Enter Tablet QA. Show the software keyboard and rotate to landscape; caret, document and toolbar remain visible. Server readback confirms exact text.
Enter =120+80 through the formula bar, observe A1=200 and save. Server readback preserves the formula. Software keyboard geometry for sheets was not tested.
Replace the title with iPad QA, save, start presentation and close using the visible close control. Server readback confirms the title.

Native Pinyin key taps and candidate selection produced 你好。 after Tablet QA in a second left-aligned paragraph. Exact server readback passed at revision 8, and the text remained visible after app termination/relaunch and reopen. The initial readback assertion incorrectly expected null alignment; the visible left-aligned toolbar and stored paragraphs agree on left. No direct text injection or clipboard paste was used for this sample. This is Word portrait basic composition only.
Full-screen simulator only; multi-window scenarios remain untested.
No native clipboard acceptance in this follow-up.
Sheet/slide Chinese composition and Word long-text, replacement, cancellation and mixed formatting remain untested.

exclusions: Physical iPad and iPhone acceptance, production backend and store distribution.
Native clipboard, sheet/slide Chinese IME, advanced Word composition scenarios, Split View, Stage Manager, external keyboard hardware and accessibility audit.
Sheet and slide portrait/expanded software-keyboard layouts; long document caret scrolling; multi-slide navigation; Office import/export and offline restart on this iPad.
These fresh iPad results do not re-certify historical iPhone or other platform runs.
